findings.description: A relocated suggestion now always goes through `inertFences`, even when the body leaves no fence open. A copied suggestion can silently pick up a U+200B after `<pre`, or have ```` ```ts title=x ```` rewritten to ```` ```text ts title=x ````. The comment at lines 53-54, which says the suggestion "is posted exactly as written", is now wrong for this path.

A failed partial pass still writes `failure`, but a successful partial retry on the same head no longer writes `success`. A red status left by a failed quick or area pass can now only be cleared by a full `@claude review`, even on a head whose full review passed.

The "tilde fence" and "raw tag" rows never reach the case their title names. Their suggestions contain no backticks, so the outer fence is 3 backticks and cannot close the body's open 4-backtick fence. The text stays inert with or without `inertFences`, so these rows only check the string transform.

The new comment at lines 230-232 argues that branch protection reads the `claude-review` state, but the `setCommitStatus` doc still says "Not a required check, so it never blocks a merge". The two comments now contradict each other, so reconcile them.
`outcome` is still built unconditionally, but only the non-partial success branch uses it now.

The non-relocated path has the same hole this PR closes for relocated anchors. A body that leaves a 3-backtick fence open turns the ````` ````suggestion ````` opener into plain content. A ```` ``` ```` line in the suggestion then closes the body's fence, and a nested ```` ```suggestion ```` after it renders live. Its impact is limited because it stays on the finding's own anchored line.
